app.name: DraftLy
hero.title: A clean starter for contracts, users, and payments.
hero.body: This frontend is built around the backend that exists today: Gmail auth, Google sign-in, QPay invoices, and a database model ready for contracts, approvals, risk analysis, files, and subscriptions.
dashboard.title: Backend capability map
dashboard.subtitle: Use this as your product cockpit while you add the next API routes.
dashboard.auth.body: Email registration, email login, Google OAuth, password hashing, and JWT issuing are implemented.
dashboard.payments.body: Create invoices, check invoice status, and receive callbacks from QPay sandbox or production.
dashboard.data.body: Prisma models already cover contracts, documents, companies, clauses, approvals, risk analysis, uploads, notifications, and subscriptions.
payments.title: QPay invoice lab
payments.subtitle: Create and check invoices through your existing backend payment routes.
auth.loginSubtitle: Log in with the account saved in your backend database.
auth.registerSubtitle: The backend currently accepts Gmail addresses and passwords with at least 8 characters.
auth.error: Something went wrong. Check the backend response and try again.
